import hashlib,json,re,yaml,html
from pathlib import Path
state=json.loads(Path('.agent/run_state.json').read_text())
gate=next(x for x in reversed(state['history']) if x.get('event')=='operator_gate_decision' and x.get('gate')=='H-GA')
assert gate['decision']=='declared' and gate['verbatim']=='GA is declared.'
assert gate['declared_version']=='1.5.0' and gate['tag']=='v1.5.0'
assert gate['evidence_exceptions']=={'real_production_pilot':'not_met','recorded_consumer_adoptions':'insufficient_evidence'}
assert gate['dossier_path']=='.agent/evidence/102/ga-readiness.json'
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(gate['dossier_path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==gate['dossier_sha256']=='d98ccec0f3c57cda51876db3286b57005143ef771b88b4c92f36748de4c0f590'
date=gate['at'].split('T')[0];assert date=='2026-10-10'
def normalized(text):
 return re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text.replace('`','').replace('**','')).strip()
def declaration(span):
 assert f'General Availability declared by the operator on {date}' in normalized(span),span
 assert not re.search(r'GA (?:is |remains )?(?:undeclared|not declared)|H-GA (?:is |stays |remains )?OUTSTANDING',normalized(span),re.I),span

 text=normalized(span)
 for key,value in gate['evidence_exceptions'].items():
  assert re.search(r'\b'+re.escape(key)+r'\s+(?:is|remains)\s+'+re.escape(value)+r'\b',text),(key,span)
 assert not re.search(r'all (?:GA |readiness )?(?:preconditions|prerequisites|criteria) (?:are |were |have been )?(?:met|passed|satisfied)',text,re.I),span
readme=Path('README.md').read_text().split('## Quickstart',1)[0];declaration(readme);assert '[GA decision](docs/planning/operator_gates.md)' in readme

con=next(l for l in rows if l.startswith('| `H-CONSOLIDATION` |'));assert 'OUTSTANDING' in con.split('|')[4] and 'NOT EXERCISED' in con.split('|')[4]
